description:
Split large feature modules into separate chunks loaded on-demand using dynamic imports. Configure webpack or bundler to create separate JS bundles for routes and heavy components.

**Rationale:** Reduces initial bundle size by 40-60%, allowing faster initial page loads. Users only download code they actually use, improving Time to Interactive.
title: Implement Dynamic Import Code Splitting
